table.ruleA: Six segments, holding volume 10,8,12,6,9,7; upper 7,6,9,5,7,5; lower 3,2,4,2,3,2; start 3,6,6,2,2,1; all QUIET; tally 0; limit 38
table.ruleB: Six crucibles, identical working volumes, marks, starting melts; all BASE; slag 0; limit 38

table.ruleA: Add the cycle's uptake row to each segment; volume not enforced
table.ruleB: Add the cycle's charge row to each crucible; volume not enforced

table.ruleA: Sequential 1..6; excess over holding volume goes to n+1 (already there when n+1 is handled); segment set to volume; excess from 6 to loss tally
table.ruleB: Sequential 1..6; excess over working volume goes to next crucible (n+1), cascading in the same step; crucible set to volume; excess from 6 to slag

table.ruleA: Reads sap as it stood after step 1, BEFORE the step-2 push. QUIET->SINK-ACTIVE if >= upper; SINK-ACTIVE->QUIET if <= lower; at most once per cycle
table.ruleB: Reads melt as it stands AFTER step 2 overflow. BASE->SUPERHEATED if >= upper; SUPERHEATED->BASE if <= lower; at most once per cycle
table.difference: Read time differs: A uses post-uptake (pre-push) values, B uses post-overflow values. Thresholds (>= upper, <= lower) are identical. Diverges whenever a position receives overflow from below (or was capped) so that its pre- and post-push values sit on different sides of a mark.

table.ruleA: Amounts from sap at start of step, state after step 3: QUIET floor(sap/4) to loss; SINK-ACTIVE floor(sap/2) to n-1; segment 1 SINK-ACTIVE amount to loss; simultaneous
table.ruleB: Same: BASE floor(melt/4) to slag; SUPERHEATED floor(melt/2) to previous crucible n-1; crucible 1 SUPERHEATED to slag; simultaneous

table.ruleA: If total strictly > 38, every segment halved (floor) – the sap kept is floor(sap/2), removed part to loss; log cycle; equality does not fire
table.ruleB: If total strictly > 38, every crucible halved (floor), removed to slag; log cycle; equality does not fire

table.ruleA: (a) end sap 1-6 (b) end states (c) state changes (cycle,segment,before,after) (d) leaf-drop cycles (e) loss tally (f) balance check
table.ruleB: (a) end melt 1-6 (b) end states (c) state changes (d) emergency tap cycles (e) slag total (f) balance check
